findings.title: Observe native allocation, copy finalization and mapping validation at their actual ports
findings.scenario: Invalid staging/copy/map usage/alignment/destroyed native resource emits error through SDK sink before or independently of callback. Raw finish/submit bypasses canonical helper; default native handler may panic, custom handler can leave only lossy callback.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Use context.submit and propagate actual cause before mapping; scope immediate staging allocation/map validation under existing native blocking policy. Preserve other-class/browser/borrowed-device limits.

findings.title: Clean mapping state on failure and cancellation
findings.scenario: Failed map exits before unmap. Rust map_context remains nonempty though native may be Idle; retry on same MAP_READ buffer asserts already mapped. Dropping wasm future at receiver await leaves original Arc buffer pending/mapped.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Arm request cleanup and release views before unmap. Failed-map unmap must reset Rust wrapper while capturing native Idle/NotMapped Validation without masking primary cause. Exclusive external mapping access is a precondition.

findings.title: Handle valid logical zero without empty native slices
findings.scenario: Logical zero over nonempty allocation is explicitly valid in binding docs and mesh upload. Nonmappable read creates zero-sized staging then SDK slice(..) panics. Mappable zero maps physical allocation and waits for no requested bytes.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: After T admission, return empty for logical zero without native copy/map/slice. Preserve ZST rejection even for zero and logical/native distinction.

findings.title: Use native usage and admit logical extent before allocation
findings.scenario: Public independently mutable size/usage can disagree with native buffer. Wrong stored usage selects wrong branch; oversized logical extent is host-allocated before native admission. On usize64 u64MAX with u8 Vec::with_capacity deterministically capacity-panics.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Check logical<=native.size before allocation/GPU work; choose native buffer.usage authority. Keep logical extent distinct. If allocating fallibly retain actual TryReserveError. No fake device/map-state query.

findings.title: Preserve native sources through armor and metal facades
findings.scenario: Armor device_error Display->Arcstr and Metal Display->String erase parser/pipeline/pass/readback sources before fitting/cache, including any newly typed Buffer failure.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Agreed cause-preserving GenerateError/backend and Metal carrier through full facades; #780 material/application/Engraving/cache consumers must migrate. Existing GenerateError::Readback source chain already works.

findings.title: Stop reading or publishing success after BatchResult Err
findings.scenario: read_staged_async ignores submission result then maps staging. Armor build_in:280 and nearest_points:351 continue likewise; metal bake:82 reads outputs and returns MetalTextures after discarded submission failure.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Propagate canonical BatchResult cause before read/success; coordinate #780-owned bake/application and other callers, no competing implementation.

findings.title: Preserve adapter and device creation errors at original boundary
findings.scenario: WgpuContext::open replaces RequestAdapterError and RequestDeviceError with message-only anyhow. Armor and Metal cannot recover those native sources downstream. Wasm surface error is also replaced.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: Preserve real SDK creation errors using existing anyhow context or owning error; coordinate exact open ownership and browser non-Send JS carrier traits.
